text: In New Zealand, the Indecent Publications Tribunal restricted Pauline Réage's The Story of O in 1967 to professional psychiatrists. In 1976, the terms of its circulation were expanded to include clinical psychologists. In 2014, the OFLC gave it an R16 classification.
meta_description: The Story of O by Pauline Réage: restricted in New Zealand in 1967 to professional psychiatrists; R16 classification in 2014.
